Food

What the kitchen makes

From the labels in the shop and what guests write in their Google reviews.

Lahmajoun and zaatar bread

Thin dough with minced meat or with zaatar. 8 Google reviews mention the lahmajoun, and one guest calls the zaatar bread the best ever.

Pies from the warmer

Halloumi pie, spinach pie and chicken pie are labelled in the warming cabinet. 7 reviews mention the pies, 4 the chicken pie.

Wraps and falafel

4 reviews mention the wraps, 3 the falafel and 2 the koupa. One guest calls the chicken wrap very filling.

From the kitchen

Photos from the Google listing.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Fresh from the kitchen

One guest writes that everything coming out of the kitchen is fresh and the dough is very soft.

Welcoming

4 reviews mention the good vibes, 2 the welcoming owner. One guest calls the premises sparkling clean.

Fair for the price

One guest who eats out a lot calls it probably the best food for the price they have tried.

On Kyriakou Matsi

At Kyriakou Matsi 57c in Egkomi, with a small terrace under the awning. Open Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 16:00 and Saturday from 9:00 to 15:00. Closed on Sunday.

What guests say

Three of 72 Google reviews, 66 of them with five stars.

“As local a shop as it gets. Everything coming out of the kitchen is fresh. The dough is so so so soft. Spanakopita has plenty of spinach and cheese. I always find pies or sandwiches leave an aftertaste but not Dora's chicken pie! Owner is very welcoming and takes pride in her shop and what she makes. Sparkling clean premises. Great spot for a quick, fullfilling lunch!”

Google review
“Best Zaatar bread I've ever had! And lovely staff and owner as well! Love this place!”

Google review
“As you can see on my profile, I eat at various types of restaurants, snack bars, et cetera and I can safely tell you this place is probably the best place I have tried im terms of food in relation to its price. I usually feel like prices are unfair in many places in cyprus because the quality is just not that good but this place is not like that. Good service and good food.”
